name: map-design
cost: Free (MIT). Bundled data is public domain. No API keys
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode and other agents that read Agent Skills
short: Your coding agent makes accurate maps, from choropleths to OpenStreetMap city posters, as one HTML, SVG and PNG.
what: The skill ships real boundary data, an offline gazetteer and a renderer. Your agent writes a short JSON spec and runs one command, and the renderer draws the map with real borders, coastlines and coordinates. It makes choropleths, bubble, spike and point maps, routes, flow maps, locator maps and city posters. Every place it matched, and every row it couldn't, is listed in a report.
who: Anyone who needs a map for a report, slide or post, or a city poster to print. It doesn't do road routing, terrain shading or your own boundary files yet.
needs: Optional: Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium for PNG export. Without one you still get HTML and SVG
An internet connection for city posters and the `streets` basemap

steps.title: Or install it as a Claude Code plugin
Or copy the folder
steps.text: Copy `skills/map-design/` into your agent's skills folder, for example `~/.claude/skills/map-design`.

steps.title: Ask for a map
steps.text: Ask the way you would ask a designer. The agent writes a spec, runs the CLI, looks at the PNG, fixes what it sees and hands you the files.

steps.title: Or run the CLI yourself
steps.text: From the cloned repo folder. `poster` writes its files to the folder you run it in.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Make a poster of Lisbon in azulejo blue.

watch: Posters download OpenStreetMap vector tiles from OpenFreeMap's free service, which has no uptime guarantee, with the public Overpass API as a fallback.
Raster basemap providers have their own access, cache and export terms, and some need a key. Keep the generated attribution visible.
Borders follow Natural Earth's de facto view, which does not match every government's official position.
The built-in country statistics are Natural Earth's 2019 estimates. For current figures, give the agent a source.
The skill is about 9 MB, mostly bundled open data.
